tracks.comment:
Chef’s Special (Off Menu)

Some records are made to fit neatly into a genre. This isn’t one of them.

Chef’s Special (Off Menu) is a 14-track collection of remixes, reinterpretations, and dance-floor experiments that travel through Afro house, Miami bass, Jersey club, tech house, baile funk, ghetto tech, juke, bass music, and everything in between.

The goal wasn’t to chase a trend or stay inside a lane. It was to ask a simple question: What happens when familiar songs are cooked differently?

Each track takes inspiration from a different corner of dance music culture while paying respect to the artists, cities, and communities that helped shape these sounds. Some moments are soulful. Some are high-energy. Some are built for the club at midnight. Others are meant for the ride home at 3 a.m.

This project is less of an album and more of a tasting menu. Fourteen courses. Fourteen different flavors. One kitchen.

Welcome to the Chef’s Special.

Not everything worth trying is on the menu.
